sourced_price_reconstruction.source: seven observed Yahoo 60-minute bars covering the complete regular session
sourced_price_reconstruction.method: first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close
sourced_price_reconstruction.adjustment: factor one only when all available daily adjustment ratios equal one and no split or dividend event occurs on the date

corporate_actions.dividends_and_spinoffs: represented only through vendor adjusted-price units; report all source spin-off events and held exposure
corporate_actions.unsupported_terminal_events: block execution; never sell at a fabricated last quote

required_sensitivity: perturb reconstructed FISV close by plus/minus one percent and report effects on selections and endpoint NAVs
